messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate and increased 429s observed in us-east-1 gateway. Service error-rate > 8% over 5m, latency p95 spiked. Pager duty: PD#INC-1599.

emma (oncall): I'm on it — paging @raj and @li. Paging cadence 30s.

raj (sre): Got it. I'm pulling gateway logs and rate-limiter metrics. Any recent deploys to quota/rate-config?

sara (prod-eng): rolled a rate-limit policy change 12m ago to tighten burst limits for the new shared-tier. config id: rl-2026-03-15-02. Deployed by canary pipeline.

li (eng-platform): I see a spike in 429 responses from the quota service followed by a spike in internal retries hitting model pools -> 502/504/500 behind frontend. Looks like strict quota rule applied to the shared gateway instead of internal-management tier (mis-scoped tag).

raj (sre): confirming sequence: 1) quota service returns 429 to client 2) client retries with backoff but without jitter -> large fanout 3) backend model pods saturate -> increased queue depth -> timeouts and 5xx.

emma (oncall): Impact? which customers/paths?

raj (sre): Quick numbers: last 10m: total gen requests 1.2M, 5xx ~120k (10%), 429s ~85k. Top affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream. Top tenants by volume: acme-inc, beta-queue-1, several small PLG orgs.

cara (customer-success): acme-inc on a dedicated support thread already reporting timeouts. They see higher error rates for longer sequences. We should open incident-notice for customers ASAP.

li (eng-platform): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) rollback the mis-scoped quota rule (rl-2026-03-15-02) -> revert to prior policy 2) apply soft-block (increase soft limits) for top-volume tenants to reduce 429 fanout 3) enable short-circuit circuit-breaker on gateway to return 429 quickly (avoid backend saturation) 4) route excess requests to fallback small-llm model to reduce pod pressure.

emma (oncall): Raj, take rollback and gating. Li, prepare routing fallback. Sara, stand by to approve rollback. Cara, prep customer notice draft with current impact numbers. Opsbot, annotate the incident timeline.

raj (sre): Rolling back now. Command: 

```
# revert quota change
kubectl -n config apply -f quota-policy-rl-2026-03-14.yaml
# confirm
curl -sS http://config-service/api/policies/active | jq '.policies[] | select(.id=="rl-2026-03-15-02")'
```

raj (sre): rollback completed and policy reload triggered (config-service responded 200). Watching rate-limiter metrics...

opsbot: NOTE: rollback action annotated by raj at 2969998912.

li (eng-platform): Enabling fallback routing rule to small-llm for non-critical traffic now. Snippet: 

```
route.rule("/v1/generate").if(request.heavy).then(route.to("small-llm"))
```

li (eng-platform): Also increasing soft limits for tenants: acme-inc, beta-queue-1, plg-staging. Pushing change as feature-flagged so we can revert quickly.

sara (prod-eng): Approved rollback and tenant soft bump. Triggering canary for routing change.

raj (sre): Observing realtime: 5xx rate dropping from 10% -> 4.2% in last 3m, 429s down 60% since rollback. Latency p95 also trending down.

cara (customer-success): Draft sent to customers: "We experienced elevated error rates affecting generation endpoints. Mitigation applied; errors reduced substantially. We will follow up with root cause and timeline." Please review.

emma (oncall): PagerDuty: acknowledged by raj. Handoff plan: I'll stay until stabilized. If rates continue to drop, hand to li for configuration follow-up and to sara for deployment gating.

raj (sre): Quick note on root cause: mis-scoped RBAC/tag or policy selector caused new rate-limit to match gateway-tier rather than internal-management. That tightened burst windows for shared traffic and created retry amplification. Ticket created: INFRA-5872 (root-cause).

li (eng-platform): Follow-ups: add stronger CI checks to policy scoping, add simulation test that injects 10% 429 and validates retries don't overflow backend, and add a guard to prevent deploys that change global gateway policies without manual review.

emma (oncall): Current state: error rates back to ~1.3% sustained over 5m, 429 down to baseline. Still monitoring for 15m. Creating public incident note for status: "mitigated, monitoring".

cara (customer-success): Sent customer notice. Key customers informed: ACME, Beta-Queue. No SLA breaches expected but CS to track any escalations.

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied at 2969998912-2969998960. Error-rate decreasing.

sara (prod-eng): We'll hold rl-2026-03-15-02 in staging and add stricter selectors before future deploys. Also tagging rollout owner in PRs.

raj (sre): Leaving alerting on tighter thresholds for next 24h and creating synthetic traffic checks for /v1/generate to ensure route stability.

emma (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline in 25m. @li you own postmortem and followups; @raj keep first-responders on watch. Marking the thread for postmortem and linking INFRA-5872.

li (eng-platform): Acknowledged. I'll coordinate the postmortem, include timeline, config diff, and recommended platform guards.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident severity lowered to SEV3 at 2969999022.

emma (oncall): Closing active paging. Thank you everyone :thumbsup: We will publish the postmortem after root-cause analysis and follow-up fixes are scheduled."
